about_the_game:
"What’s the scariest part of any campfire story? The moment you realize it might just be true."

"Campfire Stories" is a love letter to the terrifying tales of American folklore. This first chapter, "The Giant of Green Peaks," pits you against our version of a legendary cryptid. You are no longer a listener — you are the main character in a living campfire legend. Immerse yourself in a compact, intense experience of a primal fight for survival in the territory of an intelligent, stalking predator.

Feature List:

  • A New Horror Anthology: This is the first chapter in the "Campfire Stories" series, dedicated to bringing the monsters of American folklore to life.

  • Heart-Pounding Pursuit & Stealth: Experience intense chase sequences followed by tense moments of silent hiding. Your wits and patience are your only weapons.

  • Atmospheric Sound Design: A haunting tribal soundtrack and immersive soundscape of the deep woods will keep your heart racing and your nerves on edge.

  • A Compact, Gripping Experience: An intense 60-minute story that delivers a powerful, memorable horror punch.

Notice any translation inaccuracies or want to suggest localization improvements? Welcome to our Discord — we're looking forward to your edits and suggestions in the #feedback channel!

short_description: Ever wondered what you would do as the main character in those eerie campfire stories that kept you awake? Become hunted by an infamous cryptid deep in the ancient woods where you must outsmart what can't be fought — and find out! Can you survive in the terrifying Pacific Northwest wilderness?
